caption: The drawing is a black-and-white line illustration depicting a detailed front view and top-down plan of a piece of furniture, specifically a desk with an upper cabinet section. The upper cabinet is rectangular, has four doors each with a small lock, and is supported by decorative side columns. Below the cabinet, there is a desk surface with three evenly spaced drawers, each drawer featuring circular decorative elements. The legs of the desk are vertically fluted and topped with sculpted human faces just beneath the drawers. An object resembling a small post or baluster stands on the desktop surface, positioned at the center. To the lower right of the desk, the drawing includes an inset labeled “TABLE TOP PLAN,” which is a top-down schematic showing the outline of the cabinet and the tabletop with notations like “TOP CABINET,” “IMITATION BOOK ENDS,” and “ONE HALF THE SCALE.” The entire composition is done in fine black lines, and the background is the color of the paper, which is an off-white or beige tone. The drawing includes border lines and corner perspectives to suggest spatial dimensions.
title: Desk
